about: VisionClaw's first evaluation set for the words of the final answer, the development set: written on 2026-11-19 together with answers-held.json, before anything was run on either, in a blind person's casual words. Scored with tests/eval_answers.py, which carries every step out with the stand-ins of tests/live_orchestrator.py and judges the answer with tests/answercheck.py. Rules may be written from this set's misses; then measure them on answers-held.json, and write a new held-out set once that one is spent. Each request has: says, groups of words of which the answer must have one each; never, words it must not have; expect, the jobs that count as right, where they are certain; facts.web, when the user is on the web page Example Shop. The words are facts of the stand-ins: speech rate 50, symbol level some, typed characters on, typed words off; NVDA says 4:05 PM and Tuesday, November 17, 2026; the focus is on the button New Game of Space Trader; eSpeak NG speaks, the braille display is a Focus with 40 cells; drive C has 200 GB free; the Recycle Bin holds 12 items; the web page's refund policy is 30 days. Never take a request of it into known.json, a pattern's test or a note.
